releases.title: SimpleHost 0.13.0
releases.notes:
# SimpleHost 0.13.0

## Highlights
- A bright update banner now appears at the top of the local control panel whenever a new SimpleHost build is ready.
- Install an update in one click and watch the refreshed control panel reopen automatically when setup finishes.
- Keep compatible game servers online while the SimpleHost app updates, so active worlds can carry on without interruption.

## Improvements & fixes
- See exactly how many running servers can stay online and which ones need a safe restart before accepting an update.
- Let SimpleHost download and verify the GitHub release, close its control processes, launch setup, and return to the browser panel for you.
- Servers with consoles that cannot be detached safely are stopped cleanly and started again after installation.
- The Settings update action now uses the same guided installation flow as the new banner.

## Technical details
- Verified installers receive a guarded update handoff token before requesting the local app shutdown; ordinary shutdown requests cannot preserve child processes.
- Compatible processes are recorded with PID, creation time, executable path, and server state, then validated before the new app reattaches to them.
- The Windows process job drops kill-on-close only for the verified update handoff. Direct console input for a preserved process returns after that server is restarted.
- WinPTY-backed and in-progress server tasks are classified for safe restart because their live console transport cannot survive the app process exit.

We recommend updating SimpleHost to get the smoother update flow and keep compatible servers online while the app refreshes.

Download the latest version: https://simplehost-windows.veyselcalisici.chatgpt.site/

releases.title: SimpleHost 0.12.0
releases.notes:
# SimpleHost 0.12.0

## Highlights
- Meet the new Network Setup Wizard: one scan shows what is ready, what is broken, and the exact next fix.
- Fix common hosting problems directly from the report—start the server, add scoped firewall rules, retry automatic router setup, or open Internet Invite settings.
- Spot likely CGNAT and double NAT without guessing by comparing the router WAN address with the public IPv4 address.

## Improvements & fixes
- Check the active network adapter, home-router gateway, running game process, listening game ports, exact Windows Firewall rules, router mappings, CGNAT clues, and Internet Invite readiness.
- Follow focused guided pages for port forwarding, firewall setup, upstream-network issues, remote management, and the final friend connection test.
- See the exact local and public ports to enter in a router, including automatically selected public ports when the default is occupied.
- Clearly distinguish Internet Invites for SimpleHost management from the game connection players use.

## Technical details
- Firewall inspection is read-only and verifies each SimpleHost rule's enabled state, inbound direction, allow action, Private profile, protocol, and local port.
- Router WAN discovery reads UPnP status without changing router settings. Existing UPnP, PCP, or NAT-PMP leases provide mapping confirmation.
- A router-confirmed mapping cannot prove end-to-end internet reachability. The wizard says when a check is unknown and reserves final confirmation for a friend joining from another network.
- SimpleHost never asks for the router password, enables DMZ, disables a firewall, or forwards management and RCON ports.

We recommend updating SimpleHost now, then opening any server and selecting **Get Friends Connected** to run the new scan.

Download: https://simplehost-windows.veyselcalisici.chatgpt.site/

releases.title: SimpleHost 0.11.0
releases.notes:
# SimpleHost 0.11.0

## Highlights
- Invite friends on other networks to manage your approved servers through Internet Invite—no management port forwarding.
- Add VEIN, Empyrion - Galactic Survival, and ARK: Survival Evolved to the game library.
- Configure ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge mod IDs and ARK: Survival Evolved active mod order.

## Improvements & fixes
- Empyrion supports custom scenario selection and dedicated-server mod folders.
- Non-Minecraft Mods tabs now show game-specific controls instead of an incompatible Modrinth search.
- Internet invitations show connection status and retain owner approval and per-server permissions.

## Technical details
- Internet management uses an opt-in Cloudflare Quick Tunnel and encrypted ECDH/AES-GCM request envelopes, replay checks, and existing endpoint authorization. The verified Windows connector downloads on first use.
- Keep SimpleHost open. Quick Tunnel addresses change after restart; send a fresh Internet Invite to reconnect. These are experimental sessions, not a permanent relay service or game-traffic tunnel.
- New game adapters have configuration and launch-command regression coverage; full gameplay and third-party mod compatibility have not been verified. VEIN has no automatic mod installer.

Update both PCs to use Internet Invite. Enable Simple Host Network and Internet invitations, wait for Internet ready, then copy the full invitation to your friend.

Download: https://simplehost-windows.veyselcalisici.chatgpt.site/

releases.title: SimpleHost 0.10.1
releases.notes:
# SimpleHost 0.10.1

## Highlights

- Network settings stay put while you type, toggle options, and save—even while live host updates arrive.
- Copy Full Invite lets friends on the same LAN pair directly when automatic discovery is unavailable.
- See outgoing invitation status and clear instructions for owner approval and server permissions.

## Improvements & fixes

- Full invites and QR codes carry the host connection details; short codes remain supported.
- Disabled access requests now explain how to enable invitations, and startup failures no longer show a working connection.
- Unrelated settings saves no longer restart the networking service.
- LAN hosting prefers an active home-network adapter over common VPN and virtual adapters.

## Technical details

- Direct invitations validate private LAN addresses and retain certificate-pinned HTTPS and owner approval.
- Expired, revoked, or used invitations cannot grant new access; competing pending requests are declined after approval.
- Network listener readiness and discovery thread shutdown are synchronized. Browser and real HTTPS pairing regressions cover the repaired flows.

Update both PCs to 0.10.1 to use full invitations. Simple Host Network remains experimental and LAN-only.

Download: https://simplehost-windows.veyselcalisici.chatgpt.site/

releases.title: SimpleHost 0.9.3
releases.notes:
# SimpleHost 0.9.3

## Highlights

- SimpleHost now finds the newest stable release automatically.
- Updating keeps your installation location, servers, settings, and backups intact.
- The installer clearly tells you when GitHub is unavailable and still lets you use SimpleHost.

## Improvements & fixes

- Existing installations with an empty update setting now use the official SimpleHost repository.
- Install and launch preferences carry through the complete update flow.

## Technical details

- Every downloaded installer is verified against its matching SHA-256 release asset before it can run.
- Release URLs are restricted to the configured GitHub repository and trusted GitHub download hosts.
- Version checks prevent accidental downgrades and repeated installer handoffs.
- Validation passed 132 automated tests plus a live GitHub release download and checksum verification.

Publish as `v0.9.3`, mark Latest, and attach `SimpleHost-Setup-0.9.3.exe` plus `SimpleHost-Setup-0.9.3.exe.sha256`.

Users with the older 0.9.2 installer need to download this installer once to gain online setup checks. We recommend updating SimpleHost now. Application updates remain user-initiated so running servers are not interrupted without choosing to update.

Download: https://simplehost-windows.veyselcalisici.chatgpt.site/

releases.title: SimpleHost 0.9.2
releases.notes:
# SimpleHost 0.9.2

SimpleHost is a free Windows app for creating and managing game servers on your own PC through a browser-based dashboard.

## Included in this release

- Game Library support for Minecraft Java, Terraria, Valheim, Rust, 7 Days to Die, and Palworld.
- Server start, stop, restart, live console, settings, and storage controls.
- Backups, restore points, server cloning, and recovery tools.
- File management, Modrinth integration for supported Minecraft setups, schedules, and connection guidance.
- Guided Windows installer with installation-folder selection and relocation support.
- Existing installations at the same or a newer version open without reinstalling.
- Existing server data, settings, and backups remain in their selected data location during application updates.

## Hosting model

Servers run locally on your Windows PC. SimpleHost does not provide cloud hosting, so the PC must remain on and connected while hosting. Internet connections can require Windows Firewall approval, router configuration, or manual port forwarding depending on the network.

## Current boundaries

Steam-based adapters remain experimental, and readiness or graceful shutdown behavior can vary by game. Public internet reachability is not guaranteed by a local port check or router mapping. The current installer is unsigned and has not undergone release-signing or antivirus certification.

Every SimpleHost feature is included without subscriptions, paid tiers, or feature paywalls.
